about_the_game:
The supporter pack for bygone snow, with the original scans and artwork from the game in higher quality.

Features:

  • Ingame renditions of sprites and artwork

  • Original scans used for the game of Edell and Weiss

  • Scans of each frame of the final scene

  • Original concept art of the game idea from October 2021

  • HD pictures of (microwaved) frozen fettuccine alfredo

  • thank you for supporting us!!!.txt

To find the scans and art, please open the game files folder.

  • In Steam, go to the "Library" tab

  • Locate bygone snow in your library

  • Right click the game, and select the "Properties" tab

  • Select the "Local Files" tab and click on the "Browse Local Files" button

  • The images will be in the folder bygone snow supporter pack. Open with anything that can open the PNG/BMP file format.
